                    lhs=integrate(diff(sin(x)*sin(2*x), x), x, 0, pi),
                    rhs=0, relation='==', edge=False),
    oracle_instance('0', '1', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_', '_',
                    lhs=integrate(diff(x*(1-x), x), x, 0, 1),
                    rhs=0, relation='==', edge=False),
    oracle_instance('0', '1', '_', '_', 'fun _ => 0', 'fun _ => 0', '_', '_', '_', '_',
